title: Constructible direct images from embeddings into good sheaves
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Work with sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale sites [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume that every constructible sheaf $Q$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] admits a monomorphism $Q\hookrightarrow G$ into a constructible sheaf $G$ such that $Rf_*(G[0])$ has constructible homology in every integer degree [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Then every constructible sheaf $F$ has $Rf_*(F[0])$ with constructible homology in every integer degree, that is, $\mathcal C(f)$ of [def-finrepair-property-c]. No finite-type, invertible-exponent, finite-cover, or uniform cohomological-dimension hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: This records the existing proved source declaration hasConstructibleDirectImages_of_exists_mono, not a new Lean theorem. Its proof is as follows. Let P consist of derived objects whose derived f-image has constructible homology; Serre closure [thm-constructible-serre] makes P triangulated and invariant under isomorphism. Inductively, for every m and constructible F construct a map Q[-m] -> F[0] with constructible Q whose cone is in P. For m=0 use F and the identity. Given such Q, embed Q into G by the hypothesis, and put Qprime = coker(Q -> G), which is constructible by Serre closure. The short exact sequence gives Qprime[-1] -> Q -> G; shifting and composing increases m by one, and the octahedral axiom keeps its cone in P. For a nonnegative degree n take m=n+2. The right derived image of Q[-m] is concentrated in degrees >= m, so the long exact homology sequence identifies H^n(Rf_*F) with the constructible H^n of the cone. For negative n, H^n(Rf_*F)=0 by left t-exactness. This proves every integer degree without a uniform bound. All steps are already implemented in the cited source module; its printed axioms are only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

theorem hasConstructibleDirectImages_of_exists_mono {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (h : ∀ Q : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), IsConstructibleSheaf Q →
      ∃ (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (ι : Q ⟶ G), Mono ι ∧
        IsConstructibleSheaf G ∧ Etale.DerivedCategory.constructibleHomology
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) S
            ((R((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])).obj ((singleFunctor _ 0).obj G))) :
    HasConstructibleDirectImages Λ f
